description: This Java class implements the CreditDecisionConfig interface and provides configuration parameters related to credit decisions, such as interval durations, timeouts, thresholds, and batch credits. It loads configuration values from a Typesafe Config object, includes fallback mechanisms, and overrides methods for equality, hashing, and string representation.

classes.name: DefaultCreditDecisionConfig
classes.description: Immutable class that implements CreditDecisionConfig, encapsulating credit decision configuration details loaded from a Config object.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method that creates an instance of DefaultCreditDecisionConfig using a Config object with fallback.

methods.name: getMetricReportTimeout
methods.description: Returns the metric report timeout Duration.

methods.name: getCreditPerBatch
methods.description: Returns the credit per batch as an integer.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on all configuration fields.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on all configuration fields.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the config object.
